This is unusual because the interior point is not centered. The minimum triangle comes from (0,0),(1/4,0),(1/2,1/4): area = 0.5*|(1/4)(1/4) - (1/2)(0)| = 1/32. Also (1/4,0),(1/2,1/4),(3/4,0): area = 0.5*|(1/4)(1/4) - (1/4)(0)| = 1/32. Also (1/4,0),(0,1/4),(1/2,1/4): area = 0.5*|(-1/4)(1/4) - (1/4)(1/4)| = 0.5*1/8 = 1/16. Also (0,0),(1/4,0),(0,1/4): area = 1/32. So minimum is 1/32 = 0.03125. But wait: (1/2,1/4),(1/4,1),(3/4,1): the two points (1/4,1) and (3/4,1) with (1/2,1/4) give area = 0.5*(3/4-1/4)*(1-1/4) = 0.5*(1/2)*(3/4) = 3/16. Triple (1/2,1/4),(0,1/4),(1/4,0): area = 0.5*|(-1/2)(0-1/4) - (-1/4)(1/4-1/4)| = 0.5*|(-1/2)(-1/4)| = 1/16. Triple (1/2,1/4),(1,1/4),(1/4,1): area = 0.5*|(1-1/2)(1-1/4) - (1/4-1/2)(1/4-1/4)| = 0.5*(1/2)(3/4) = 3/16. Triple (1/2,1/4),(3/4,0),(1,1/4): area = 0.5*|(1/4)(1/4) - (1/2)(-1/4)| = 0.5*|1/16+1/8| = 3/32. So minimum appears to be 1/32. But I claim 1/64 = 0.015625 which is conservative. Actually, the triple (0,1/4),(1/2,1/4),(1,1/4) is collinear (all on y=1/4), giving area 0!
